title: Future: Scene application domains (virtual worlds, simulation) are Baize-scale projects
description: Scene is a spatial substrate. Each application domain built on it (virtual worlds, simulations, etc.) is a Baize-scale project — not a guide or thin companion spec. Baize needed a full engine (schemas, rules, AI, hidden info, 58+ games) with a thin Scene binding; a Second Life / OASIS-style virtual world would need equivalent-scale projects for land/parcels, economy/currency, inventory/transfer, scripting/behaviors, portals/world-graphs, marketplace, and reputation. Some of these may also need JMAP-level companion specs for wire format (e.g. parcel ownership as a JMAP data type), but the bulk of the work is application-layer, not protocol-layer. Not urgent — note for future exploration when deployment pain demands it.
